scientific_integrity: Occupation density and two-point correlation precedents are acknowledged. Symbolic checks corroborate analytical identities; no independent scientific audit or uniqueness guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Results require infinite unweighted regular trees, iid single uniform arrivals, nearest-neighbor exclusion, distinct three-neighbor cumulants for degree at least three; finite simulations cannot certify infinite-volume claims; bibliographic comparison with some historical correlation papers remains partial.
title: Full neighbor-count law and a negative third cumulant in jammed tree adsorption
